description:
Configure the store for a 'Soft Launch' state. First, create a new CMS Page with the title 'Coming Soon', URL Key 'coming-soon', and content '

We are launching soon!

Stay tuned for our grand opening.

'. Enable this page. Second, navigate to Stores > Configuration > General > Web and set the 'Default Web URL' (CMS Home Page) to this new 'Coming Soon' page. Finally, in Stores > Configuration > General > Design > HTML Head, enable the 'Display Demo Store Notice'. Save all configurations. If not logged in, use admin/Admin1234!.
